newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mercantile Mutual funds inflow rises.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mercantile Mutual funds inflow rises.

text.p: Australian financial services group Mercantile Mutual Ltd said on Tuesday it had increased its insurance premium and investment funds inflow by 47 percent to A$1.55 billion for the year ended September 30, 1996.
Mercantile Mutual is a unit of Dutch insurance and banking group Internationale Nederlanden Groep NV.
Managing director Rod Atfield said in a statement the group's strong growth was largely a result of its continuing good investment performance and improved investment conditions.
Mercantile said life premium income rose 61 percent to A$1.003 billion in the year to September.
Mercantile said single premium income rose 96 percent to A$662 million and regular premium income by 20 percent to A$341 million.
It said the figures did not include the premium income or funds inflow of the recently acquired Pacific Mutual group or financial planning subsidiaries RetireInvest, Advisor Group and Bleakleys.
